_comment: 2026 Senate cycle configuration for the control simulation. dem_safe_seats / rep_safe_seats count seats NOT in the competitive list (holdovers + safe 2026 races such as FL, NE, MT): of the 9 competitive races Democrats hold GA, MI, NH (3) and Republicans hold NC, ME, OH, TX, IA, AK (6), so dem_safe = 47-3 = 44 and rep_safe = 53-6 = 47. dem_majority_threshold is 51 because the sitting VP (R) breaks 50-50 ties. Fundamentals: each race carries the state's Dem-minus-Rep presidential margin in 2024 and 2020; the fundamentals prior blends them (pres_weight_recent on 2024) and is blended into the polling margin with weight blend_k/(blend_k+num_polls), so it anchors thinly-polled races and fades as polls accumulate. MI is primary-pending (Aug 4) - Stevens is a placeholder. wikipedia overrides the default article title (Ohio is a special election).
